before: Layout recomputed per-paragraph inputs on every line or pass, digested every element of a paragraph separately, and hashed with a SHA-256 that copied its input per call.
after: Layout keeps per-paragraph inputs per immutable node, writes a paragraph's content into one digest, and hashes into reused buffers; the digests and the pages are those of the same inputs.
reason: Only local layout work changes. Nothing about layout enters shared state, operations, snapshots or protocol messages.
